rubric.role_summary: Hands-on laser scientist for an Austin laser facility, setting up, aligning, troubleshooting, and running laser experiments for a laser-driven inertial fusion program.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Hands-on laser scientist for an Austin laser facility, setting up, aligning, troubleshooting, and running laser experiments for a laser-driven inertial fusion program.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Hands-on experience with laser systems.
- Hands-on experience with nonlinear optics.
- Hands-on experience with laser beam characterization and optical alignment and diagnostics.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Familiarity with laser modeling software, such as Miro or Zemax, and CAD tools, such as Inventor.
- Hands-on experience with fiber and free-space laser systems.
- Hands-on experience with nonlinear optics, including frequency conversion and beam smoothing.
- Experience working independently on bench-level setup, alignment, and troubleshooting.
- Working knowledge of ANSI Z136 laser safety standards and experience operating safely in Class 3B/4 laser environments.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Austin, TX area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
